scenario.description: Metro MAN: HQ plus two remote sites (15-35 km), 450 users and a FinTech colo. Focus: OS2 SMF, EVPL, sub-5 ms QoS, dual-homed failover.

media.rationale: Selected Cat6a (10GBASE-T) because the 90 m run is within the 100 m limit defined by IEEE 802.3an; Cat6a sustains 10 Gbps at this distance without active optics.

Selected OM4 Multimode Fiber (10GBASE-SR) because the 300 m run exceeds the 100 m copper limit but remains inside the 400 m OM4 reach at 850 nm, where modal dispersion and attenuation stay within budget.

Selected OS2 Single-Mode Fiber because link distance (22.0 km) exceeds the 400 m attenuation limit of OM4 Multimode Fiber. Chose 10GBASE-ER (1550 nm) with a calculated link loss of 6.7 dB against a 10.5 dB budget (5.5 dB fiber + 1.0 dB connectors + 0.2 dB splices); nominal reach is 40 km.

vlans.name: Corporate
vlans.rationale: VLAN 10 (Corporate) carries HQ corporate users on 10.10.0.0/24 with gateway 10.10.0.1. Trunks permit only VLANs 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 999; native VLAN 999 is reserved and unused to prevent double-tagged VLAN hopping. RSTP role: designated.

vlans.name: Trading
vlans.rationale: VLAN 20 (Trading) carries Low-latency trading floor on 10.10.1.0/25 with gateway 10.10.1.1. Trunks permit only VLANs 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 999; native VLAN 999 is reserved and unused to prevent double-tagged VLAN hopping. RSTP role: designated.

vlans.name: Voice
vlans.rationale: VLAN 30 (Voice) carries Trading turret/voice on 10.10.1.128/26 with gateway 10.10.1.129. Trunks permit only VLANs 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 999; native VLAN 999 is reserved and unused to prevent double-tagged VLAN hopping. RSTP role: designated. PoE is enabled on access ports for this VLAN (802.3af/at budget planned per AP).

vlans.name: Guest
vlans.rationale: VLAN 40 (Guest) carries Visitor access on 10.10.1.192/26 with gateway 10.10.1.193. Trunks permit only VLANs 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 999; native VLAN 999 is reserved and unused to prevent double-tagged VLAN hopping. RSTP role: designated.

vlans.name: Management
vlans.rationale: VLAN 50 (Management) carries Out-of-band management on 10.10.2.32/27 with gateway 10.10.2.33. Trunks permit only VLANs 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 999; native VLAN 999 is reserved and unused to prevent double-tagged VLAN hopping. RSTP role: root (priority 4096).

vlans.name: Colo-DMZ
vlans.rationale: VLAN 60 (Colo-DMZ) carries FinTech colocation services on 10.10.2.0/27 with gateway 10.10.2.1. Trunks permit only VLANs 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 999; native VLAN 999 is reserved and unused to prevent double-tagged VLAN hopping. RSTP role: designated.

routing.rationale: Selected multi-area OSPF because the design spans 2 remote site/WAN link(s) or exceeds 50 subnets. Area 0 remains the transit core, while remote areas isolate SPF churn and permit route summarisation.

rationales.condition: largest-first allocation with CIDR boundary alignment
rationales.rationale: Allocated 6 subnets from 10.10.0.0/16 using largest-first VLSM. Address-space utilisation is 0.88% and host utilisation is 79.43%.
Allocated 10.10.0.0/24 to Corporate: 254 usable addresses, gateway 10.10.0.1, wildcard 0.0.0.255. Blocks are aligned and checked for overlap with all previously allocated subnets.
Allocated 10.10.1.0/25 to Trading: 126 usable addresses, gateway 10.10.1.1, wildcard 0.0.0.127. Blocks are aligned and checked for overlap with all previously allocated subnets.
Allocated 10.10.1.128/26 to Voice: 62 usable addresses, gateway 10.10.1.129, wildcard 0.0.0.63. Blocks are aligned and checked for overlap with all previously allocated subnets.
Allocated 10.10.1.192/26 to Guest: 62 usable addresses, gateway 10.10.1.193, wildcard 0.0.0.63. Blocks are aligned and checked for overlap with all previously allocated subnets.
Allocated 10.10.2.0/27 to Colo-DMZ: 30 usable addresses, gateway 10.10.2.1, wildcard 0.0.0.31. Blocks are aligned and checked for overlap with all previously allocated subnets.
Allocated 10.10.2.32/27 to Management: 30 usable addresses, gateway 10.10.2.33, wildcard 0.0.0.31. Blocks are aligned and checked for overlap with all previously allocated subnets.

Selected multi-area OSPF because the design spans 2 remote site/WAN link(s) or exceeds 50 subnets. Area 0 remains the transit core, while remote areas isolate SPF churn and permit route summarisation.

rationales.rationale: VLAN 50 (Management) carries Out-of-band management on 10.10.2.32/27 with gateway 10.10.2.33. Trunks permit only VLANs 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 999; native VLAN 999 is reserved and unused to prevent double-tagged VLAN hopping. RSTP role: root (priority 4096).

rationales.condition: segmentation by function with explicit trunk policy
rationales.rationale: VLAN 60 (Colo-DMZ) carries FinTech colocation services on 10.10.2.0/27 with gateway 10.10.2.1. Trunks permit only VLANs 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 999; native VLAN 999 is reserved and unused to prevent double-tagged VLAN hopping. RSTP role: designated.

rationales.condition: loop prevention with deterministic root selection
rationales.rationale: Selected Rapid PVST+ with per-VLAN root priority 4096 on the management VLAN so that each VLAN has a deterministic root and sub-second reconvergence after a topology change.
Selected dual-homed design with a paired gateway peer because the scenario requests resilience beyond a single uplink. HSRP/VRRP removes the gateway as a single point of failure.

rationales.choice: EF priority queue + CS3 signalling bandwidth
rationales.rationale: Selected a strict priority queue for DSCP EF and a reserved bandwidth class for CS3 because the scenario requires 5 ms application latency. Lower latency-sensitive traffic is shaped by class-default.

configs.switches.cfg:
! NetArchitect generated switch configuration
! Profile: metro-man
! Review interface names, port counts, and PoE budgets before applying.
!
hostname metro-man-sw1
!
ip routing
!
! --- VLAN database ---
vlan 10
 name CORPORATE
!
vlan 20
 name TRADING
!
vlan 30
 name VOICE
!
vlan 40
 name GUEST
!
vlan 50
 name MANAGEMENT
!
vlan 60
 name COLO-DMZ
!
vlan 999
 name NATIVE_UNUSED
!
! --- Spanning tree ---
spanning-tree mode rapid-pvst
spanning-tree vlan 50 priority 4096
!
! Resiliency: dual-homed. Deploy paired distribution switches and an HSRP/VRRP gateway peer.
!
! --- VLAN gateways (SVIs) ---
interface Vlan10
 description Corporate gateway
 ip address 10.10.0.1 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown
!
interface Vlan20
 description Trading gateway
 ip address 10.10.1.1 255.255.255.128
 no shutdown
!
interface Vlan30
 description Voice gateway
 ip address 10.10.1.129 255.255.255.192
 no shutdown
!
interface Vlan40
 description Guest gateway
 ip address 10.10.1.193 255.255.255.192
 ip access-group GUEST_ISOLATION in
 no shutdown
!
interface Vlan50
 description Management gateway
 ip address 10.10.2.33 255.255.255.224
 no shutdown
!
interface Vlan60
 description Colo-DMZ gateway
 ip address 10.10.2.1 255.255.255.224
 no shutdown
!
! --- Uplink trunk (explicit allowed VLANs) ---
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description Uplink trunk to distribution/core
 switchport trunk encapsulation dot1q
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk native vlan 999
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,30,40,50,60,999
 switchport nonegotiate
 no shutdown
!
! --- Access ports (sample; expand to match endpoint count) ---
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/1
 description Access - Corporate
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 10
 spanning-tree portfast
 spanning-tree bpduguard enable
!

 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 10
 spanning-tree portfast
 spanning-tree bpduguard enable
!

configs.router.cfg:
! NetArchitect generated router configuration
! Profile: metro-man
!
hostname metro-man-rtr
!
! --- LAN trunk and VLAN subinterfaces ---
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description LAN trunk to L3 switch
 no ip address
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0.10
 description Corporate gateway
 encapsulation dot1Q 10
 ip address 10.10.0.1 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0.20
 description Trading gateway
 encapsulation dot1Q 20
 ip address 10.10.1.1 255.255.255.128
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0.30
 description Voice gateway
 encapsulation dot1Q 30
 ip address 10.10.1.129 255.255.255.192
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0.40
 description Guest gateway
 encapsulation dot1Q 40
 ip address 10.10.1.193 255.255.255.192
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0.50
 description Management gateway
 encapsulation dot1Q 50
 ip address 10.10.2.33 255.255.255.224
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0.60
 description Colo-DMZ gateway
 encapsulation dot1Q 60
 ip address 10.10.2.1 255.255.255.224
 no shutdown
!
! --- WAN uplink ---
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description WAN (OS2 single-mode fiber, 10GBASE-ER)
! Replace the documentation /30 with the carrier-provided link.
 ip address 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.252
 no shutdown
!
! --- OSPF ---
router ospf 1
 router-id 10.10.0.1
 passive-interface default
 no passive-interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 no passive-interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 network 10.10.0.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
 network 10.10.1.0 0.0.0.127 area 0
 network 10.10.1.128 0.0.0.63 area 10
 network 10.10.1.192 0.0.0.63 area 10
 network 10.10.2.0 0.0.0.31 area 20
 network 10.10.2.32 0.0.0.31 area 20
 area 10 range 10.10.1.128 255.255.255.128
 area 20 range 10.10.2.0 255.255.255.192
!
end
configs.acl.cfg:
! NetArchitect generated guest isolation ACL
! Applied inbound on guest SVIs (see switches.cfg).
ip access-list extended GUEST_ISOLATION
 remark Block guest VLANs from internal address space
 deny ip any 10.10.0.0 0.0.255.255
 deny ip any 10.0.0.0 0.255.255.255
 deny ip any 172.16.0.0 0.15.255.255
 deny ip any 192.168.0.0 0.0.255.255
 permit udp any any eq 53
 permit tcp any any eq 443
 permit ip any any
!
end
configs.qos.cfg:
! NetArchitect generated WAN QoS policy
! Target application latency: 5 ms
! Apply after router.cfg; the interface already exists there.
class-map match-any VOICE
 match dscp ef
class-map match-any SIGNALLING
 match dscp cs3
!
policy-map WAN-QOS
 class VOICE
  priority percent 30
 class SIGNALLING
  bandwidth percent 10
 class class-default
  fair-queue
  random-detect
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 service-policy output WAN-QOS
!
end
